description: No recent deploy, no downstream issue. Memory has been climbing linearly for 6 hours -- invisible in the default 30-minute window, where it just looks like a high-but-flat plateau. Visible only once the window is widened. OOM kill in the logs at alert time. Correct root cause: a slow memory leak. This scenario specifically tests whether the agent widens the window instead of tunnel-visioning on the default 30 minutes.
correct_root_cause_summary: A slow memory leak climbed for roughly 6 hours before the alert; the OOM kill at alert time is the symptom, not the start of the story. No deploy and no downstream dependency issue caused this.

logs.message: OOM killer invoked: killed process recommendations-worker (pid 4821)
